skill.summary: Print files (often inbound attachments from chat apps like Feishu/Lark, or any local file path) on Windows. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks to print (...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of windows-print skill.
- Allows printing of files on Windows only upon clear, explicit user instruction (e.g. "print", "打印").
- Supports selection of printer, multiple copies, and optional wait for print job.
- Files are printed via bundled PowerShell scripts, accepting inbound attachments or local file paths.
- Enforces strict safety: never prints files automatically or based on inferred intent; always confirms with user before printing.
